info.title: Blexchat API
info.description: REST API for Blexchat — social commerce DM and comment automation platform supporting Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, and Messenger.

post.summary: Issue a new token and revoke the current one

put.summary: Update the authenticated user's preferred language

post.summary: Reply to a commenter via DM
Send a message in a conversation

get.summary: Home screen — all dashboard data in one call
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's stats, all connected channels, the 10 most recent conversations (unread-first), the 5 most active automations, and the 10 latest unanswered comments. Use the `next_cursor` in `conversations` to load more.

unread_messages.description: Sum of unread_count across all open conversations

auto_replies_today.description: Automated DMs + auto comment replies today

channels.description: All connected channels (usually few — no pagination needed)

next_cursor.description: Pass to GET /api/v1/conversations?cursor= to load more

recent_comments.description: 10 latest comments that have not been auto-replied yet

post.summary: Receive Meta platform events (comments, DMs, reactions)

sanctum.description: Obtain a token from POST /api/v1/auth/login and send it in the Authorization header.
